newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch stocks were boosted late in the session on Thursday by a firm start on Wall Street, sending the AEX index of blue chips to another record close.
Early negative sentiment was gradually turned around during the day, as the domestic bond market edged higher.

The AEX index closed 3.74 points higher at 685.02 points, beating the previous record close of 681.28 scored on Wednesday. It peaked at an intra-day record just ahead of the close of 686.01, outpacing Wednesday's 685.10 points.
"We saw some profit-taking early but then once again good buying came in, on financials and cyclicals," one dealer said.
